description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream keybindings doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md, 197 lines) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts (reference)

## Output

Create docs/keybindings.md

## How to adapt

1. **Config Path**: Update from `~/.pi/agent/keybindings.json` to our path.

2. **Key Format**: The `modifier+key` format is the same. Document our modifier system:
   - `ctrl`, `shift`, `alt` (combinable)
   - Keys: letters a-z, digits 0-9, special keys (escape, enter, tab, etc.), function keys f1-f12, symbols

3. **All Actions Tables**: Convert each action category:
   - **TUI Editor Cursor Movement**: `tui.editor.cursorUp`, `tui.editor.cursorDown`, etc.
   - **TUI Editor Deletion**: `tui.editor.deleteCharBackward`, etc.
   - **TUI Input**: `tui.input.newLine`, `tui.input.submit`, `tui.input.tab`
   - **TUI Kill Ring**: `tui.editor.yank`, `tui.editor.yankPop`, `tui.editor.undo`
   - **TUI Clipboard and Selection**: `tui.input.copy`, `tui.select.up`, etc.
   - **Application**: `app.interrupt`, `app.clear`, `app.exit`, `app.suspend`, `app.editor.external`, `app.clipboard.pasteImage`
   - **Sessions**: `app.session.new`, `app.session.tree`, `app.session.fork`, `app.session.resume`, `app.session.togglePath`

4. **Custom Keybindings**: Document our keybindings.json format:
   ```json
   {
     "tui.editor.cursorLeft": ["left", "ctrl+b", "alt+b"],
     "app.exit": ["ctrl+d", "ctrl+shift+q"]
   }
   ```

5. **Reloading**: Document our `/reload` command for applying keybinding changes.

6. **Migration**: Document our migration of pre-namespaced ids to namespaced ids.

## What to preserve verbatim

- The key format specification
- All action names (they are part of our internal API)
- The default keybindings (verify they match our actual defaults)
- The modifier combinations

## Key upstream references to include

- [keybindings.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All action names match our actual keybinding IDs
2. All default bindings match our actual defaults
3. All paths match our config directories
